Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle. Quezon City http: //wmv. dilggov.ph 01 FEB OPINION NO. MS. ANNIE G. BELTRAN Acting City Treasurer, Tagum City Office the City Treasurer G/F City Hall Government Center J.V. Ayala Avenue, Brgy. Apokon Tagum City, Davao del Norte Dear Ms. Beltran: This has reference to your letter dated 24 October 2018 requesting for this Department's legal opinion relative to the implementation of Memorandum Circular No. 2010 dated 23 September 2010 entitled "BANNING NAMES OR INITIALS AND/OR IMAGES OR PICTURES OF GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS IN BILLBOARDS AND SIGNAGES OF GOVERNMENT PROGRAMS, PROJECTS AND PROPERTIES". The query is on whether it is allowed to put the image of the Municipal Mayor together with the President on the business plate. The layout of business license plate which was attached for reference also contained the signature of the Mayor. The directive of Memorandum Circular No. 2010, series 2010 is clear and unequivocal. It prohibits the practice of putting up billboards and signages and other information materials bearing the names, initials or pictures of government personalities on all government projects, and government properties. The premise for such violation was even laid down as: 1. To refrain from associating the President's personality and identity in government programs and projects; and 2. To uphold good local governance. The issuance of a Business License Plate is part of the implementation of a government program intended to be displayed by business establishments; hence, said Business License Plate is within the contemplation of "signages and other information materials" mentioned by the aforecited Memorandum Circular. Relative to this, it cannot be argued that the Mayor and the President are government officials whose images and

names are not to be displayed in such Business License Plate pursuant to the same Memorandum Circular. Finally, let these wordings of Memorandum Circular No. 2010, series 2010, be simply and practically understood: "Government projects and properties xxx must only contain the official seal or name of the local government unit. " We hope to have enlightened you on the matter. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY MARI EL C. SACENDONCILLO, CESO 111 Undersecretary Copy Furnished: DIR. ALEX C. ROLDAN, CESO V DILG Region Xl
